content.title: No Kings March 28 Protest: Find a rally near you, get sign ideas, tell your friends!
content.text: The second No Kings rally in October 2025 in Anchorage, Alaska. Credit: Caroline Grass In this article: 1. About No Kings 2. Find a local rally 3. Protest sign ideas 4. Spread the word 1. About No Kings 2. Find a local rally 3. Protest sign ideas 4. Spread the word In 2025, millions of people in the United States and worldwide joined the No Kings movement to peacefully protest President Trump’s power-hungry, corrupt administration. The upcoming March 28 No Kings protest will be the third – and possibly largest – peaceful No Kings day of action. Get ready for the March 28 No Kings Protest: FAQs 1. What is No Kings? President Trump acts like a wanna-be king: disregarding the Constitution, defying the courts, and terrorizing our communities. He continually puts the wellbeing of everyday Americans at risk to benefit his corporate cronies. All the while, the rising costs of groceries, gas, energy, housing, and healthcare are crushing families around the country. No Kings is a peaceful movement to protest the Trump administration’s blatant disregard for the law and our fundamental rights. The No Kings March 28 protest is an opportunity to remind everyone that our country belongs to the people – not strongmen or greedy billionaires. Together, we’ll send a message: We won’t sit back and let the Trump administration drive up our costs, risk our health and our environment, and erode our democracy. 2. How can I find a No Kings March 28 protest near me? Organized by a broad coalition, the March 28 No Kings protest includes more than 3000 events across the country, from small towns to big cities. Go to nokings.org to find an event near you. You can also find a Resource Guide and register for Upcoming Trainings to get more information on how to prepare and stay safe. By attending No Kings events, we can unite across the country to defend our democratic values, strengthen our communities, and stand strong in the face of authoritarianism. 3. What are some good No Kings protest sign ideas? If you want to bring a sign to your local protest to show your support with a little extra flair, we’ve got you covered. Check out these ideas for No Kings protest signs from patriotic to creative to classic: Patriotic Sign Ideas: Show that we’re the real patriots defending our nation and our democracy with classic USA symbols in your design like the flag, bald eagles, the Statue of Liberty, and of course lots of red, white and blue. Break out your flags from July 4th too! Historical throwbacks: Try a paraphrase from the Declaration of Independence, like “It is our right, our duty, to throw off such a Government.” “This is the government the Founders warned us about” “Nothing is more American than opposing tyranny” “The Boston Tea Party was the original No Kings Rally!” “Remember what happened to our last mad king?” “Yes I WOULD like to keep my republic, Mr. Franklin” “Patriotism means to stand by the country. It does not mean to stand by the president.” – Teddy Roosevelt “Tyranny Falls When People Rise” “No Kings in America Since 1776” “No Kings, No Dictators, No Oligarchs” “King Free Forever!” Democracy defense: “Defend Democracy” “Red, white, and BLUE WAVE!” “Don’t Tread On Our Voting Rights” “Vote like our democracy depends on it” “Vote like your rights depend on it” “This is what a Democracy looks like” “Democracy not Autocracy” “Democracy doesn’t fear protest – Dictators do” “Democracy is not a spectator sport” “Democracy for 250 Years and Counting” “We shouldn’t have to protect democracy from the President” “Good Trouble is my civic duty” “Democracy dies in silence” “Stop Trump, Save Democracy” “Honk if you love democracy!” Constitution callbacks: “Of the People, By the People, For the People” “We the People Defend Democracy” “We the People, not the Plutocrats” “We the People Stand Together” “We Have a Constitution, Not a King” “Loyalty to the Constitution, not the President” “SCOTUS: Protect Our Constitution!” People power: “The Power of the People is Stronger than the People in Power” “This is what a Patriot looks like” “I love the USA BECAUSE we have no kings” “Stop pretending your racism is patriotism” “Pro-America, Anti-Trump” “We are better than this!” “Freedom not Fascism” “Freedom not Fear” “Resist Fascism” Creative and Funny Sign Ideas: For the fandoms: Hamilton fans: “History has its eyes on you” Swifties: “I’m just mad as hell ’cause I loved this place” Beyhive: “Get the f*ck up out my house [drawing of the White House]” or “America Has a Problem” or “When you hurt me, you hurt yourself…don’t hurt yourself” Lizzo fans: “We coulda had a bad b*tch” RATM fans: “Rage Against the Regime” People over oligarchs: “We can’t afford a Tyrant in the White Bespoke: Save Money.” “He’s made billions, but are you better off?” “We aren’t being governed, we’re being looted” “They blame immigrants so you don’t blame billionaires” “Stop the billionaire takeover” “Planet over Profit” Activists unite: “Imagine being afraid of diversity but not dictatorship” “Only caring about your own rights is exactly how you lose them” “Equal rights for others doesn’t mean fewer rights for you – it’s not pie” “Trump is a climate disaster” “If you aren’t angry, you haven’t been paying attention” “We the People are Pissed” “Go Fact Yourself” “All of my outrage can’t fit on this sign” “No sign is big enough to list all of the reasons I’m here” “Thanks Trump, you turned me into an activist!” “Not a paid protestor – I’m here for free!” Clever catchphrases: “They’re eating the checks, they’re eating the balances!” “Trump is the worst president since Trump” “No Kings but Short Kings” “No Kings, Only Queens!” “No Faux-King Way!” “We need a leader, not a Faux-King liar” “You’re not a King, you’re a Clown!” “No Cons, No Clowns, No Kings” “No Crown for the Clown” “KingCon” “It’s Giving Small Dictator Energy” “If not fascism, why fascism-shaped?” “No Kings – that means you TACO!” “IKEA has better Cabinets” “No monarchs except butterflies” Classic Sign Ideas: “Power to the People!” “Power to the Peaceful!” “Hate Will Not Make Us Great” “When hate is loud, love must be louder” “Courage is Contagious!” “Things are so bad even the introverts are here” “When injustice becomes law, resistance becomes duty” “We are the ones we’ve been waiting for!” “A woman’s place is in the resistance” “Girls just wanna have fundamental rights” “People of quality don’t fear equality” “I dissent!” 4. How can I spread the word about the next No Kings protest? Invite your friends and family to join you at No Kings! Spread the word and share our No Kings posts on social media: Tell Congress: Reject the SAVE Act 2.0! Republicans are trying to pass the “SAVE Act 2.0,” the biggest legislative rollback of voting rights in our country's history. It threatens voting access for 146 million Americans who don't have a passport, millions who can't easily access a birth certificate, rural voters, voters of color, voters with disabilities, survivors of climate disasters, and the tens of millions of people who have changed their names.
